listings.name: Bamolapisi Construction and Plant Services
listings.current_description: Bamolapisi Construction and Plant Services is a home-building company based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, offering start-to-finish residential construction -- from site inspection and architectural drawings to foundations, roofing, plumbing, electrical work and final handover -- across Gauteng and Mpumalanga.

listings.name: Battery Fix & Solar
listings.current_description: Battery Fix & Solar, drawing on 30 years in the electronics industry, sells and services batteries and solar power solutions in Heuweloord, Wierdapark, and reconditions lead-acid batteries with eco-friendly technology to restore at least 80% of their original capacity.

listings.name: Berg Projects PTY Ltd
listings.current_description: Berg Projects PTY Ltd, based in Garsfontein, is a home maintenance and construction company for sectional titles, estates and private homes across Gauteng, offering waterproofing, plumbing, electrical and painting services along with 24/7 emergency maintenance for body corporates.

listings.name: Bhekanani Building & Construction
listings.current_description: Bhekanani Building & Construction, founded in July 2002 and 100% Black owned and managed, is a general building and civil construction company on Poinsettia Street in Sinoville, handling steel structure fabrication, repairs and restorations on occupied, fully operational sites.

listings.name: Big Save Waltloo
listings.current_description: Big Save Waltloo is a family-run supermarket on Zasm Street that traces its roots to 1989 as Waltloo Wholesalers, growing into an all-in-one grocery, fresh produce, toiletries and liquor retailer with over 1,000 employees across the Tshwane area.

listings.name: Body Fuel Express - Rooihuiskraal
listings.current_description: A water refill and beverage kiosk in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, offering RO purified water refills, water containers, juice, slush puppies, frozen yoghurt, ice cream, coffee, biltong and braai spices as part of the Body Fuel Express (Just Water Group) chain.

listings.name: Booysen Accountants (PTY) Ltd. (Gauteng Office)
listings.current_description: Booysen Accountants (Pty) Ltd is an accounting, tax, and payroll firm founded in 2011, with offices in Pretoria (Gauteng), Greytown (KwaZulu-Natal), and Jacobs Bay (Western Cape), offering monthly accounting, cloud accounting systems, tax planning, business valuations, and payroll services.

listings.name: Botes Land Surveyors
listings.current_description: Botes Land Surveyors is a professional land and engineering surveying firm based in Pretoria East, offering construction setting-out and as-built surveys, 3D laser scanning, BIM modelling, cadastral and topographical surveys, and drone/LIDAR mapping across Gauteng and neighbouring provinces.

listings.name: Botha Bezuidenhout Attorneys Inc
listings.current_description: Botha Bezuidenhout Attorneys Inc is a Val-de-Grace, Pretoria law firm established in 2015 by Eugenie Botha and Schalk Bezuidenhout, handling civil litigation, corporate and commercial disputes, consumer protection matters and employment law, with both retainer and hourly billing options.

listings.name: Box-It Pretoria East
listings.current_description: Box-It Pretoria East, operating since 2003 from Moreleta Park, Pretoria, supplies packaging materials and storage solutions including moving boxes, document storage boxes, bubble wrap, packing tape, bin boxes and wooden crates and pallets for residential, commercial and industrial customers.

listings.name: Bradlows
listings.current_description: Bradlows Pretoria Central is a furniture and appliance store on Central Street in the Pretoria CBD, part of the JD Group furniture retail chain, selling bedroom, living room, dining, and appliance ranges with in-store shopping, in-store pickup, and delivery.

listings.name: Brand et al
listings.current_description: BRAND et al is the lead agency of the et al GROUP, a level 1 B-BBEE marketing and consultancy network based in South Africa that combines specialist member agencies to deliver integrated marketing strategy services across the marketing spectrum.

listings.name: Bras Trucking
listings.current_description: Bras Trucking is a Pretoria-based logistics and freight transport company operating a large DAF truck fleet (tri-axles, super-link flat-decks, tautliners, side-tippers and tankers), and also sells new and used DAF and ERF truck parts through its Bras Parts division.

listings.name: Brick3D
listings.current_description: Brick3D (now trading as Vector CNC) is a Pretoria-based supplier of CNC machines and components, including spindle motors, VFDs, endmills, servo and stepper motors, power supplies and motion controllers, operating as an online store with appointment-based collection in Zwavelpoort.

listings.name: Bushbaby Communication
listings.current_description: Bushbaby Communication is a creative services and event management company based in Sable Hills Waterfront Estate, Pretoria, providing corporate communications, event management, photography, and videography, with clients including the City of Tshwane, City of Johannesburg, and the SA Army.

listings.name: Business Growth Marketing Group
listings.current_description: Business Growth Marketing Group is a digital marketing agency based in Wierdapark, Centurion, offering local SEO, website design, Google Business Profile management, reputation management, and social media marketing for small and medium-sized businesses across Gauteng and the Western Cape.

listings.name: Cabstrut - Pretoria
listings.current_description: Cabstrut is a South African manufacturer of cable management and power distribution support systems, including cable ladders and a full range of cable support systems, holding ISO 9001 and DNV certification; this listing is its Pretoria branch in Rietfontein.

listings.name: CAILEB CONSTRUCTION(PTY)LTD
listings.current_description: Caileb Construction (Pty) Ltd, established in 2014, is a 100% black-owned, Level 1 BEE road construction and maintenance company based in Amandasig, offering road rehabilitation, milling, chip and spray seals, asphalt surfacing, and CIDB-graded (7CE, 6SB, 5GB) construction work.

listings.name: Cape Union Mart Wonderpark
listings.current_description: Cape Union Mart is a South African outdoor gear and clothing retailer, founded in 1933, selling hiking, camping, travel and adventure equipment including its own K-Way and Old Khaki brands; this branch operates from Wonderpark Shopping Centre in Karenpark.

listings.name: Car Inspection
listings.current_description: Car Inspection is an independent pre-purchase vehicle inspection service based in Montana, Pretoria. It sends qualified mechanics to a location of the customer's choosing to perform a 150-point inspection on used cars, helping buyers assess a vehicle before purchase.

listings.name: Castor & Ladder
listings.current_description: Castor & Ladder, based in Hennopspark, Centurion, is a manufacturer and distributor of aluminium access equipment, fiberglass and aluminium ladders, trolleys, steel storage equipment, and castors and wheels, and has operated since the 1960s as part of Argent Industrial.

listings.name: Chantel Van Heerden Incorporated
listings.current_description: Chantel Van Heerden Incorporated (CVH Attorneys), established in March 2011 and based in Pretoria East, is a law firm practising family law (antenuptial and postnuptial agreements, divorce, children's court matters), conveyancing, civil litigation, evictions, debt collection and notarial work.

listings.name: Checkers Irene Link
listings.current_description: This Checkers outlet opened in 2022 as the group's seventh store in Centurion, based in the newly developed Irene Link Mall in Doringkloof, and offers a bakery, deli, fresh produce, a salad bar and prepared meals alongside everyday groceries.

listings.name: Ciber Consulting (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Ciber Consulting is a technology and management consulting firm based in Pretoria that supports African public institutions with national-scale technology programmes, including information systems, licensing and registration platforms, secure identity credentials and procurement support, operating across nine African countries.

listings.name: CIC Cleaning Services
listings.current_description: CIC Cleaning Services is a residential and commercial cleaning company in Moregloed, Pretoria, offering window and gutter cleaning plus end-of-tenancy and once-off cleans; it started as a mobile car wash in 2023 before rebranding to cleaning services in 2024.

listings.name: CIPC Registrations
listings.current_description: CIPC Registrations, operated via cipcregistration.co.za by BusinessNeeds (Pty) Ltd, provides guidance and support for CIPC company registrations, amendments, annual returns, beneficial ownership declarations, BEE affidavits, and related compliance services, plus business bank account, website, and domain assistance.

listings.name: CIRC
listings.current_description: CIRC (Corporate Industrial and Risk Consultants) is a Monument Park-based firm providing Compensation Fund and Workmen's Compensation administration, including COID registration, Letters of Good Standing, Return of Earnings, and Injury on Duty claims management for employers across South Africa.

listings.name: City Logistics Centurion
listings.current_description: City Logistics Centurion is part of City Logistics, a Southern African supply chain company established in 1988 that provides first- and last-mile transport, e-commerce delivery, and dedicated transport solutions, operating alongside subsidiary brands Fastway Couriers and AGX International Logistics.

listings.name: Clevercom (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: A Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria-based technology company providing software development, VoIP and PBX telephony, SMS/USSD messaging, system integration and networking hardware for businesses, with products including a CRM tool (CleverFin), an issue tracker (Clever Tickets) and bulk SMS tools.

listings.name: Clicks Lyttelton 2
listings.current_description: Clicks Lyttelton 2 is a branch of the Clicks pharmacy and health and beauty retail chain, in the Lyttelton Shopping Centre on the corner of Cantonments Road and Botha Avenue, Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, open daily from 8am to 6pm.

listings.name: Clinigen South Africa
listings.current_description: Clinigen South Africa is a specialist pharmaceutical company based at Route 21 Corporate Park, Irene, Pretoria, supplying proprietary and in-licensed specialist medicines and, through its Equity Medical Technologies subsidiary, medical devices, including access to hard-to-find medicines via Clinigen Direct.

listings.name: Compensation Relief
listings.current_description: Compensation Relief, founded in 2004, is a Waverley-based consultancy that helps medical practices and other organisations comply with the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COID), including recovery of occupational injury and disease fees and related claims management.

listings.name: Computer Swop & Repairs
listings.current_description: Computer Swop & Repairs, based in Villieria, Pretoria, buys and sells new and pre-owned computer hardware, software, and consumables, and offers repairs, on-site technician call-outs, insurance damage assessments, data security consultation, cloud and networking solutions, and electronic waste disposal.

listings.name: CSM Engineering (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: CSM Engineering (Pty) Ltd, based in Hennopspark, Centurion, manufactures and installs steel, mild steel and stainless steel projects, offering precision machining, welding, fabrication and drilling services, and distributes Festo and SMC pneumatic products across South Africa and neighbouring countries.

listings.name: Daisy Business Solutions Pretoria North - COPIERS - PABX - CCTV
listings.current_description: This is the Pretoria North (Sinoville) branch of Daisy Business Solutions, a South African technology services provider, specialising locally in copiers, PABX telephone systems and CCTV security installations as part of the company's broader IT, telecoms and print offering.

listings.name: Dela Plast
listings.current_description: Dela Plast is a family-owned plastic injection moulding company established in 2002, manufacturing products for the food packaging, agricultural, security, warehousing and engineering industries from its factory in Koedoespoort. The company is FSSC 22000 certified for food packaging manufacturing.

listings.name: Delitech (PTY) Ltd
listings.current_description: Delitech is an IT services and connectivity provider serving Centurion and Pretoria East, offering computer and hardware repairs, remote IT support, network troubleshooting, managed business IT support, fibre and LTE internet packages, web design, hosting and data recovery services.

listings.name: Digital 4 Jesus (PTY) LTD
listings.current_description: Digital 4 Jesus (Pty) Ltd is a Pretoria-based digital marketing agency in Murrayfield offering SEO, Google Ads and Analytics management, content and social media marketing, WordPress and e-commerce website design, mobile app development, and lead-generation and CRM automation services.

listings.name: Doorstuds
listings.current_description: Doorstuds is a South African e-commerce retailer of decorative door hardware, including round and square door studs, mock hinges, handles, knockers, sliding/barn door hardware, grilles and lock plates, offering nationwide delivery from its Koedoespoort Industrial premises in Pretoria.

listings.name: EasyFlo
listings.current_description: EasyFlo is a South African software company based in Akasia that provides an integrated HR and operations management platform covering payroll, roster scheduling, time and attendance, stock and logistics, and vehicle management, available across web, mobile and server platforms.

listings.name: ECU-Warehouse
listings.current_description: ECU-Warehouse sells, supports and installs engine management systems (ECUs) from its Wonderboom South store, as an authorised dealer of South African-manufactured engine management systems, serving both online and walk-in customers with free same-day delivery on orders over R2,000.

listings.name: Edladleni Trading and Projects
listings.current_description: Edladleni Trading and Projects is a construction and engineering company based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, offering building construction, renovations, extensions and general contracting services. The company says it began operating in 2012 and holds a CIDB 1GB PE contractor grading.

listings.name: Elma's
listings.current_description: Elma's is a family restaurant in Mayville Mall that has traded continuously since opening as a BJ's franchise in 1992, rebranding as Elma's in 2007; the menu spans international comfort food such as mac-and-cheese, chicken and ribs, and waffles.

listings.name: Enbiosis SA
listings.current_description: Enbiosis SA, based at Alenti Office Park on Witherite Road in The Willows, offers AI-powered gut microbiome analysis -- using metagenomic sequencing of a stool sample to generate personalised diet and gut-health insights for healthcare practitioners and their patients.

listings.name: ERA Real Estate South Africa
listings.current_description: This is the ERA Pretoria East branch, located at 392 Lynnwood Road and established in 1979, one of the longer-running offices in the ERA Real Estate franchise network, offering residential property sales and rentals in the Pretoria East area.

listings.name: Foto Discount World
listings.current_description: Foto Discount World is a camera and photographic equipment retailer in Montana Park, trading since 2003 as an official dealer for brands including Canon, Sigma and Fujifilm, selling DSLRs, mirrorless cameras, camcorders, binoculars and tripods, and offering onsite repairs.

listings.name: Foundation for Professional Development
listings.current_description: The Foundation for Professional Development is a Pretoria-based training and capacity-development organisation, established in 1997, whose School of Health Sciences trains healthcare professionals and offers short courses accredited for CEU points by the Health Professions Council of South Africa.

listings.name: Garment Care SA
listings.current_description: Garment Care SA is a dry-cleaning and laundry detergent manufacturer based in Icon Industrial Park, Sunderland Ridge, producing professional cleaning solutions, detergents and accessories for the dry-cleaning and laundry trade, and supplying customers across South Africa and neighbouring countries.

listings.name: Gecko Ridge Wedding Venue
listings.current_description: Gecko Ridge Wedding Venue is a wedding and function venue on the banks of the Pienaars River near Mooiplaas, with chapels and banquet halls accommodating between 20 and 600 guests for weddings, conferences and other functions, plus on-site accommodation.

listings.name: Gigi's Furniture Removals Gauteng
listings.current_description: Gigi's Furniture Removals has moved homes and offices across Gauteng and the Western Cape since 1966, offering private storage and packing services, closed-body vehicles to protect goods from the weather, and R150,000 goods-in-transit insurance included on every move.
